narrative.overview: HUONGMUOI remains the parent identity; Trọ Thái Nguyên names the local service. Its wordmark and restrained gold detail carry recognition. The rental experience earns trust through actual room records, explicit costs and local context. The interface uses an editorial property-journal pace with warm paper, confident serif headlines, direct Vietnamese copy and real listing photography. Search and management screens stay practical and scannable.
keyCharacteristics: HUONGMUOI wordmark with a local service descriptor
Cormorant Garamond with Be Vietnam Pro
Warm paper and forest ink with sparing terracotta and brass
Room facts and counts come from actual records

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Counts, rent, availability and nearby distances must come from the records shown. If demo data is empty, say so instead of filling the gap with an estimate.

rules.name: The Plain-Language Rule
rules.body: Serif headlines set the mood; every action and housing fact stays in direct, familiar Vietnamese.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary surfaces flat. Reserve shadows for meaningful overlap and interaction.

dos: Do keep the supplied HUONGMUOI logo intact and identify the service beside it.
Do make Trần Minh Quân · 0357041593 a callable tel link.
Do derive local counts and prices from room records.
donts: Don't invent reviews, availability, popularity, verification or business contact details.
Don't substitute resort imagery for room listings.
Don't add motion to controls that do not need it.
